chunks: So hasten, may Allah have mercy on you, to your houses
which you have been commanded to populate, and towards which you have been encouraged, and invited.
And seek the completion of Allah's favors upon you by patience in His obedience, and avoidance of His disobedience, for tomorrow is close to today.
How fast are the hours in the day, and how fast the days in the month, and how fast the months in the year, and how fast the years in the lifespan!
ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ali describe the rapid passage of time and its spiritual significance?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) employs the rhetorical device of *tarabbus* (anticipation) to urge believers to actively race toward their destined spiritual stations, framing time not merely as a passive flow but as an accelerating force that compresses years into moments. This passage, central to the theme of *Zuhd* (asceticism) in Nahj al-Balagha, underscores the Shia emphasis on balancing hope in divine mercy with the sobering reality of *al-Ghad* (the imminent Day), urging immediate action before the 'hours' of life slip away.
